hazard_description: High-draw DMX/HMI lighting distribution near wet set surfaces, condensation, or metallic truss.
engineering_controls: Class-A 5mA GFCI inline protection on all wet-area distribution drops; Elevated cable ramps, rubber matting, and bonded stage ground; IP65 weather-sealed DMX splitters & ballast isolation stands
ppe_required: EH-rated insulated rubber-sole footwear; Insulated electrical handling gloves (Gaffer crew)
notes: CSATF Bulletin #1 (General Safety) & CSATF Bulletin #22 (Electrical / Wet Location Safety).

hazard_description: Overhead truss/softbox rigging, tensioned wire/fabric loads, and elevated working-at-height perimeter.
engineering_controls: Secondary rated steel safety cables on all overhead fixtures & truss points; Certified load-cell shackles with 5:1 working load limit (WLL) safety factor; Tool-tether lanyards and barricaded drop-zone beneath riggers
ppe_required: ANSI Z89.1 climbing/rigging hard hat; Full-body fall-arrest harness (>1.8m elevation); Steel-toe work boots
notes: CSATF Bulletin #1 (Overhead Rigging / Fall Protection) & ANSI E1.6.
